speech.heard: In Russia, 64.1% of adults hold short-cycle tertiary qualifications. In India, only 12.4%. Russia is the world's highest, leading all 143 countries and territories on the globe. India falls far behind, where few adults finish this stage of education. The benchmark counts the population ages 25 and over that completed short-cycle tertiary education. Side by side, the gap between both nations is massive. The rest of the world falls in between, with a median of 21.3%. How common is short cycle tertiary education where you live?
